subject: Re: reps.run and progress
body: Matches my plan. Headless reps.run returns a handle {session: Promise<RepSession>, stop(reason)} with onStep callbacks so you render the screen; I can also export mount(el, props) with onDone if your slot needs it. Progress and the installed rule are pure: reps.status(profile, sessions) and reps.progress(sessions). Default rep is 32 s timed (20-40 s bounds) plus the two ratings.
